name: globetrotter
description: GlobeTrotter — a personalized, interactive multi-city travel planning platform.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --schema prisma/schema.prisma && npm run seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.setup:push: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run seed
